license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for: 1. Any person to practice or attempt to practice podiatric medicine in this state as defined by the applicable laws or as otherwise defined, or to hold himself out to the public in this state as a podiatric physician, doctor of podiatric medicine, podiatrist, foot doctor or foot specialist without having first obtained a license to practice podiatric medicine from the Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners

age_minimum.quote: Be more than twenty-one (21) years of age

moral_character_required.quote: Satisfies the Board, in the case of any criminal conviction, that the crime does not substantially relate to the practice of podiatric medicine nor pose a reasonable threat to public safety, or constitute an act of moral turpitude that would affect the practice of podiatric medicine or public safety

degree_required.quote: a podiatric medicine educational institution which confers the degree of Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (D.P.M.), or its equivalent

accrediting_body.value: Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association, Inc.
accrediting_body.quote: meets all of the requirements for accreditation by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association, Inc.

required.quote: Satisfactorily completes a podiatric surgical residency, approved by the Council of Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association, of not less than three (3) years

duration.quote: not less than three (3) years; provided, the provisions of this paragraph shall only apply to applicants after March 1, 2018

kind.quote: Satisfactorily completes a podiatric surgical residency, approved by the Council of Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

exams.name: Board Examination (written and oral)
exams.notes: Board may utilize the National Board of Podiatric Examiners' National Board Examination Part III as the written portion; passing score of 75% required on both portions
exams.quote: The Board may utilize the National Board of Podiatric Examiners' National Board Examination Part III as the written portion of the state licensing exam.

interval_years.quote: Each license to practice podiatric medicine shall be renewed by June 30 of even-numbered years.

required.quote: upon showing proof of compliance with Section 145.1 of this title, a licensee shall be entitled to have his/her license to practice podiatric medicine renewed

available.quote: By way of reciprocity and without examination, the Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners may issue a license to practice podiatric medicine in this state

requirements.value: Must satisfy all qualifications for licensure by examination, have lawfully practiced podiatric medicine for at least 3 years in another US state/territory, and pay the required fee. Reciprocity extends only to states that extend substantially equal or greater reciprocity privileges to Oklahoma citizens.
requirements.quote: for at least three (3) years immediately prior to the date on which he pays the required fee he lawfully practiced podiatric medicine within and under the laws of a district or territory or other state of the United States of America

regulatory_model.quote: without having first obtained a license to practice podiatric medicine from the Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners

title_protection.quote: to hold himself out to the public in this state as a podiatric physician, doctor of podiatric medicine, podiatrist, foot doctor or foot specialist without having first obtained a license to practice podiatric medicine

scope_protection.quote:
It shall be unlawful for:
1. Any person to practice or attempt to practice podiatric medicine in this state as defined by the applicable laws or as otherwise defined

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making a false and material statement to the Board before or after license issuance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making a false and material statement to the Board, either before or after the issuance of a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pleading guilty or being convicted of a felony substantially related to podiatric medicine that poses a reasonable threat to public safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pleading guilty or nolo contendere to, or being convicted of, a felony crime that substantially relates to the practice of podiatric medicine and poses a reasonable threat to public safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using alcohol, drugs, or other substances that impair the licensee's ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using alcohol, any drug, or any other substance which impairs the licensee to a degree that the licensee is unable to practice podiatric medicine with safety and benefit to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being mentally or physically incapacitated to a degree that prevents safe practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being mentally or physically incapacitated to a degree that the licensee is unable to practice podiatric medicine with safety and benefit to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making untrue or misleading advertisements or representations calculated to deceive the public or patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any advertisement, statement, or representation which is untrue or improbable and calculated by the licensee to deceive, defraud or mislead the public or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing fraud in the examination, in obtaining a license, or in obtaining renewal or reinstatement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing fraud by omission or commission in the examination given by the Board, or in obtaining a license, or in obtaining renewal or reinstatement of a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay required fees promptly when due
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay or cause to be paid promptly when due any fee required by the Podiatric Medicine Practice Act or the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing podiatric medicine in an unsafe or unsanitary manner or place
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing podiatric medicine in an unsafe or unsanitary manner or place

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or attempting to perform surgery for which the licensee has not had reasonable training
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, or attempting to perform, any surgery for which the licensee has not had reasonable training

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross and willful neglect of duty as a member or officer of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross and willful neglect of duty as a member or officer of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees with unauthorized persons or entities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing with any person, firm, corporation, or other legal entity any fee or other compensation for services as a podiatric physician, except with another podiatric physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate the Podiatric Medicine Practice Act, Code of Ethics, or Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate the provisions of the Podiatric Medicine Practice Act, the Code of Ethics, or the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering opioid drugs in excess of statutory maximum limits
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes

definition_quote.value: Podiatric medicine is that profession of the health sciences concerned with the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and ankle, including the local manifestations of systemic conditions, by all appropriate systems and means.
definition_quote.quote: Podiatric medicine is that profession of the health sciences concerned with the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and ankle, including the local manifestations of systemic conditions, by all appropriate systems and means.

methods_authorized.quote: examining, diagnosing, recommending for, prescribing for, caring for or treating ... Massage or adjustment ... Fitting, building, or otherwise furnishing pads, inserts, appliances, inlays, splints, or supports, or giving or using medicament or anesthetics

drug_authority.value: May prescribe, dispense, and administer medications including anesthetics; subject to opioid prescribing limits
drug_authority.quote: giving or using medicament or anesthetics in connection with such examining, diagnosing, recommending, prescribing, treating, caring for, or fitting

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: Podiatric medicine is that profession of the health sciences concerned with the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and ankle

anesthesia_authority.quote: giving or using medicament or anesthetics in connection with such examining, diagnosing, recommending, prescribing, treating, caring for, or fitting

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and ankle

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: Satisfactorily completes a podiatric surgical residency, approved by the Council of Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association, of not less than three (3) years

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and ankle, including the local manifestations of systemic conditions

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: The sale of proprietary or patented foot remedies, pads, supports or corrective shoes; ... The fitting or recommending of appliances, devices, or shoes for the prevention, correction, or relief of foot ailments or troubles, by regularly established retail dealers or their regular salesmen
